people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: They took them from the middle of the tent, and brought them to Joshua and to all the children of Israel. They laid them down before Yahweh.
translations.bsb: They took the things from inside the tent, brought them to Joshua and all the Israelites, and spread them out before the LORD.
translations.kjv: And they took them out of the midst of the tent, and brought them unto Joshua, and unto all the children of Israel, and laid them out before the LORD.
translations.asv: And they took them from the midst of the tent, and brought them unto Joshua, and unto all the children of Israel; and they laid them down before Jehovah.
